title: Geometric phase for an accelerated two-level atom in AdS spacetime
summary: We have investigated the geometric phase acquired by a uniformly accelerated Unruh-DeWitt detector coupled to vacuum fluctuations of a massless conformal scalar field in anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime. Using the open-quantum-system formalism, we calculate the phase under three boundary conditions (Dirichlet, transparent, and Neumann) imposed on the field at the AdS boundary. Our findings reveal a sharp distinction between subcritical and supercritical accelerations.
